    Demonic War

    👤 Nethra's Secret War¶

    After the explosion, Nethra survived as a new kind of Shadow. She moved covertly and without the knowledge of the other Shadows, changing history from the shadows of the shadows.

    She secretly created the Ironcloak, who came to worship her as their goddess. She fed them fragments of truth — enough to keep the flame alive, never enough to reveal her own existence. The Erisian Church constantly accused the Ironcloak of heresy, eventually excommunicating them — but by that point, the Church was too corrupt and too weak to execute them.

    Nobody in the Ironcloak knows Nethra's true identity — except for the upper echelon.

    👤 The Beast in the Ruins¶

    Rulfred survives. He wears Goldenborn's corpse — the entity now known as Dragon Yaldabaoth, a fallen dragon guarding the Ruins of Baoth. The Hybrians unleashed the Leviathan into the newly created sea to enforce an absolute quarantine. No one enters. No one leaves.

    The Shadows believe they are still hidden. They do not know that Nethra walks among them.

    🔗 Who Were the "Demons"?¶

    [!WARNING] Note on Terminology The name "demon" is a historical corruption. These beings were allies during The Last Great War — one of the species who fought alongside the human-led coalition against the Hybrian hivemind. Their original name has been lost. The term "demon" was applied centuries after Baoth's fall, likely by the Erisian church as part of its broader campaign to delegitimize any power that predated its own myth.

    The demons are not native to Ge'or. They arrived with the crash, same as dragons, dwarves, elves, and humans.

    🔗 Connection to the Present¶

    1. The Hybrian Shadows survived. Kirivis's sacrifice slowed them — but did not stop them. They retreated deeper, waited, and re-emerged centuries later as the architects of the Erisian cult.
    2. Rulfred lives. He wears Goldenborn's body as Dragon Yaldabaoth, guarding the ruins alongside the Leviathan.
    3. Nethra lives. She operates in total secrecy, a Shadow among Shadows, unknown even to her own Ironcloak faithful.
    4. The Archive of the Traveler inside the Ruins of Baoth contains the only complete record of the Demon King's war — and possibly the only evidence of Hybrian activity that predates the Erisian era.

    🕸️ Chronological Placement¶

    • Hybrian spaceship falls: 2989 BGD
    • Kirivis receives the tablet: ~526 BGD
    • 60 years of study: 526–466 BGD
    • 10 years of planning and army building: 476–466 BGD
    • The War: 466–421 BGD — Baoth annihilated
    • The Explosion: 421 BGD — Sea of Leviathan formed
    • Aftermath: Age 9 — Age of Anarchy (399 to 300 BGD), extreme poverty and corruption
    • Nethra founds the Ironcloak: sometime after 421 BGD, in secret
